edges.description: BAF-complex chromatin remodeling is required for embryonic cardiogenesis; SMARCC1 depletion produces structural cardiac defects rescued by wild-type but not patient-variant SMARCC1, establishing an extra-neural developmental branch whose cardiac progenitor intermediates remain incompletely mapped.

Embryonic BAF-complex dysfunction across mesodermal/skeletal developmental programs is associated with occasional congenital skeletal abnormalities in SMARCC1 probands, though tissue-specific skeletal intermediates have not yet been dissected directly.
Obstruction of the cerebral aqueduct impedes CSF flow, producing obstructive (non-communicating) congenital hydrocephalus.
Cerebral aqueduct obstruction combined with prenatal neuroepithelial dysgenesis enlarges the cerebral ventricles, often detectable in utero.
Knockdown reproduces the aqueductal stenosis of the human structural brain malformation, with wild-type (but not variant) SMARCC1 rescue.
edges.limitations: Amphibian morpholino knockdown models acute gene depletion rather than a heterozygous human germline variant, and cannot reproduce the full human neurodevelopmental phenotype.

edges.description: The homozygous missense mouse reproduces the neural stem cell proliferation defect and apoptosis that underlie the human mechanism. Note this model's reduced proliferation is the opposite direction to the Baf155/Baf170 forebrain conditional knockout, which retains proliferation while blocking differentiation.
edges.limitations: The mouse carries a homozygous missense allele rather than the human heterozygous loss-of-function state, and its neural-tube phenotype is exencephaly rather than the hydrocephalus/aqueductal stenosis seen in patients, so the structural outcome is not directly reproduced.

nodes.description: Loss of BAF-complex remodeling impairs interaction with and potentiation of the H3K27 demethylases UTX/KDM6A and JMJD3/KDM6B (as well as LSD1/KDM1A at proliferation loci), shifting the permissive-repressive chromatin balance so repressive H3K27me3 marks accumulate across neuronal-differentiation genes. Established in Baf155/Baf170 conditional-knockout mouse forebrain rather than in the human heterozygous state.

nodes.description: Dysregulated transcription impairs neuronal differentiation and neurogenic output of ventricular-zone neural stem and radial glial progenitors in the developing telencephalon, the neural-stem-cell basis of SMARCC1-associated congenital hydrocephalus. Mouse alleles diverge on progenitor proliferation direction: the Baf155/Baf170 forebrain conditional knockout keeps progenitors proliferating symmetrically while blocking differentiation (PMID:29779894), whereas the homozygous Baf155msp/msp missense mouse shows defective neural stem cell proliferation and increased apoptosis (PMID:33077954). Only the shared impaired-differentiation and disrupted fetal neuro-gliogenesis outcome is bound here.

nodes.description: Heterozygous, frequently de novo or incompletely penetrant transmitted, loss-of-function or conserved-domain missense variants in SMARCC1 reduce the functional dosage of BAF155, a core scaffold subunit of the chromatin-remodeler class of the epigenetic machinery (mammalian SWI/SNF / BAF complex, including neural progenitor npBAF complexes). Haploinsufficiency is the primary disease mechanism, supported by extreme population loss-of-function constraint and by wild-type rescue in vivo.

nodes.description: Catheter-based neurosurgical CSF diversion to decompress obstructive hydrocephalus and elevated intracranial pressure. While shunting can acutely decrease intracranial pressure and ventricular size, pediatric shunts carry substantial early failure rates (13.8% pooled 30-day failure across pediatric hydrocephalus) and, because the underlying lesion is prenatal parenchymal neuro-gliogenesis dysgenesis, CSF diversion may fail to normalize ventriculomegaly or improve neurodevelopmental and epileptic outcomes.
